_comment: Canary for the fail-open crypto tables. Both ports' tables are keyed by server tool name and silently encrypt/decrypt NOTHING for an unrecognized name, so a server-side tool rename that isn't mirrored here ships plaintext without any test failing. This fixture pins the exact table contents; it is checked into BOTH repos byte-for-byte (tests/fixtures/crypto_tool_tables.json) and asserted against each port's tables. A server tool rename must update the server, this fixture in both repos, and both crypto tables in the same change.
